title: Payment types, taxes, and order types
intro: Configure how orders are classified and settled: payment methods, tax rules, and service types (dine-in, delivery, etc.).

sections.title: Payment types
steps: Open the Payment types tab.
Define Cash, Card, and custom tenders shown on the payment screen.
Set sort order and whether a type requires reference or change calculation.
sections.caption: Payment types tab.

sections.title: Taxes
sections.intro: Taxes apply to dishes and appear on receipts and reports.
steps: Open the Taxes tab.
Create tax rates and link them to applicable items or order types.
Save so new orders calculate tax correctly.
sections.caption: Taxes tab.

sections.title: Order types
steps: Open the Order types tab.
Configure dine-in, takeaway, delivery, and other service modes.
Order types drive kitchen routing, reporting, and default behaviors.
sections.caption: Order types tab.

sections.title: Extras
sections.intro: Extras are automatic surcharges linked to payment types, order types, or tables (e.g. service fees or cover charges).
steps: Open the Extras tab.
Create extras with name, amount, and applicability rules.
Save so qualifying orders include the surcharge on payment.
sections.caption: Extras tab.

sections.title: Payment type form
sections.intro: Payment types include local methods and Remote gateway types that delegate to Stripe, PayPal, etc.
steps: Open Admin → Payments → Types.
Add name, priority, and type (Cash, Card, Remote, …).
For Remote: pick gateway provider, mode (test/live), and API keys.
Optionally link tax and automatic discounts.
Save — type appears on payment screen and table restrictions.
sections.caption: Payment type form with remote gateway.

fields.name: Name
fields.effect: Label on payment screen buttons.

fields.name: Priority
fields.effect: Sort order among payment methods.

fields.name: Type
fields.effect: Behavior profile — choose Remote to enable gateway fields.

fields.name: Gateway provider
fields.effect: Stripe, PayPal, or other integrated processor.

fields.name: Gateway mode
fields.effect: Test vs. live credentials.

fields.name: public_key
fields.effect: Client-side or publishable API key for the gateway.

fields.name: secret_key
fields.effect: Server-side secret used to capture charges.

fields.name: webhook_secret
fields.effect: Validates asynchronous payment callbacks.

fields.name: client_id / client_secret
fields.effect: OAuth-style gateways that use paired credentials.

fields.name: merchant_id / integrity_salt
fields.effect: Provider-specific merchant and hash fields.

fields.name: Tax
fields.effect: Default tax rule applied when this type is used.

fields.name: Discounts
fields.effect: Auto-applied discount rules tied to the payment method.

sections.title: Tax form
steps: Open Payments → Taxes.
Define name, rate, and inclusive/exclusive behavior.
Save — assign to payment types or order defaults.
sections.caption: Tax form.

fields.name: Name
fields.effect: Tax label on receipts.

fields.name: Rate
fields.effect: Percentage applied to taxable amounts.

fields.name: Inclusive
fields.effect: When true, tax is embedded in displayed prices.

sections.title: Order type form
steps: Open Payments → Order types.
Set name and behavior flags (dine-in, takeaway, delivery).
Save — used on tables, POS, and reporting.
sections.caption: Order type form.

fields.name: Name
fields.effect: Order type shown on checks and filters.

fields.name: Priority
fields.effect: Sort order in selectors.

fields.name: Default
fields.effect: Pre-selected type for new orders when applicable.

sections.title: Extra (service charge) form
sections.intro: Extras add automatic surcharges (service charge, coperto) by payment or order context.
steps: Open Payments → Extras.
Name the charge and set amount or percent.
Configure when it applies (order type, payment type, etc.).
Save — qualifying orders include the surcharge.
sections.caption: Extra surcharge form.

fields.name: Name
fields.effect: Surcharge label on guest receipt.

fields.name: Amount / rate
fields.effect: Fixed currency or percent of eligible total.

fields.name: Taxable
fields.effect: Whether tax is calculated on the surcharge.

fields.name: Auto apply rules
fields.effect: Links to order types, payment types, or floors.
